finds.notes: Path pattern: guhoyas.com/stats/bko/bkc/{YYYYMMDD}/{3-letter-opp-code}.at.gae.box.html (or gae.at.{opp} for away games). This was a 'Total Sports'/TotalCast-branded template circa 2000-01 hosted directly on guhoyas.com (not the sidearm CMS used today). Discovered via Wayback CDX: curl 'http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=guhoyas.com/stats/bko/bkc/*&filter=original:.*box.*'. Printer-friendly PDF versions also referenced (e.g. /other/bko/bkc/2001/01/12/1216box.pdf) but not independently verified — the HTML box.html versions ARE full box scores and were directly fetched and read.

finds.verified_sample: https://storage.googleapis.com/vucommodores-prod/2019/05/vand_m_baskbl_1991_8_misc_non_event__1991-92BoxScores.pdf (real PDF behind the wrapper at https://vucommodores.com/documents/a133f362-cda3-43cc-b383-eaf85fd02a73.pdf, linked as "Box Scores" for the 1991-92 season on https://vucommodores.com/vanderbilt-mens-basketball-year-by-year-results-statistics/)
finds.coverage_claim: The official 'Year-By-Year Results & Statistics' page lists a 'Box Scores' PDF link per season for 1978-79 through 1991-92 (14 seasons, all verified present via HTML link text), then a gap where 1992-93 through 1998-99 only have 'Final Stats' (no box scores), then Box Scores resume 1999-00 through 2001-02 and continue into the 2000s. 29-page multi-game PDF for 1991-92 = one page per game, full scanned scorer's sheet (handwritten/typed) for both teams.
finds.notes: Sidearm JS-wrapper quirk confirmed exactly as briefed: /documents/{uuid}.pdf returns an HTML shell; grep the HTML for storage.googleapis.com/vucommodores-prod/... to get the real PDF. Page itself requires a real browser UA + following the 301 redirect (bare URL without trailing slash) to load; WebFetch alone returned only the title.

finds.verified_sample: https://umterps.com/documents/download/2026/4/1/1995-96_mbb_box_scores.pdf
finds.coverage_claim: Direct PDFs at the pattern /documents/download/2026/4/1/{season}_mbb_box_scores.pdf return HTTP 200 for every season 1992-93 through 2001-02 (10 seasons probed and confirmed); 1991-92 and earlier at the same pattern 302-redirect to /404, so this specific archive starts at 1992-93. Each PDF (7 pages for 1995-96) is a compact multi-game 'Game Summaries' document covering the full season, one condensed box per game per team.
finds.notes: This is a genuine text PDF (not scanned) — pdftotext extracts real per-player rows directly, no OCR needed. Found via web search hit on a 2026-04-01 upload; the official Libraries digital collection (lib.umd.edu .../mens-basketball-media-guides) may extend coverage further back but returned HTTP 400 on fetch and wasn't verified.

finds.verified_sample: https://usctrojans.com/news/1999/12/30/USC_Men_s_Basketball_Box_Score (Northwestern at USC, played 12-29-99, Los Angeles Sports Arena)
finds.coverage_claim: USC published individual 'news' articles titled '[Sport] Box Score' or '{Opponent} vs USC ... Box Score' containing the complete plain-text NCAA-format box score as the article body. Confirmed live examples from Mar 2000, Dec 1999 (verified sample), Nov 2001, and Dec 2001 (women's) via search hits, spanning at least the 1999-2000 through 2001-02 seasons pre-dating the cutoff. No single index page was found; games surface individually via search, so full-season coverage is unconfirmed but the pattern and quality are verified.
finds.notes: Page is SSR'd via Nuxt; plain WebFetch only returns the <title>. The real box score text lives inside a <script id="__NUXT_DATA__" type="application/json"> blob — grep that JSON for 'OFFICIAL BASKETBALL BOX SCORE' to pull the full plain-text table out via curl.
